description.value: Ann Marie's Cafe is a well-regarded diner in Abbotsford that has been voted Best Breakfast in the city, serving classics like burgers, sandwiches, and breakfast dishes. It offers both dine-in and takeout with online ordering for pickup. Sitting on George Ferguson Way, it makes a practical and popular refueling stop for cyclists riding through the Fraser Valley.

address.value: 33771 George Ferguson Way, Abbotsford, BC V2S 6H1
